name: J. J. Clemmer
role: Cresco, Iowa, partner in the Clemmer & Dell Cave Hills ranch
bio: J. J. Clemmer of Cresco, Iowa, was a partner in the Clemmer & Dell cattle ranch in the Cave Hills and in 1885 planned to use Polled-Angus bulls only. In August 1885 he reported an Aberdeen-Angus calf that gained 150 pounds in forty days on grass.

moments.label: Switched his Cave Hills herd to Polled-Angus bulls
